The '''Squad Pod''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] modified [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] used to transport [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] operatives.

==Characteristics==
Squad Pods were a one-way means of transportation onto a planet's surface, with each pod programmed to automatically head towards its landing point. They could also perform evasive maneuvers, although usually a distraction was required to prevent them from being shot down.
